title: Ahana and the Trains
logline: A cozy bedtime visit with Mira the Mongoose about trains, ending calm.

beats.beat: Ahana notices something about trains and grows curious.
Mira the Mongoose arrives and they set off together to look closer.
They meet a small, easy puzzle to do with trains.
Ahana helps solve it by being kind and patient.
Mira the Mongoose says goodnight and Ahana settles down, cozy and calm.

emotional_arc: curiosity rising gently, then softening into a calm, sleepy ending
